name: ตอร์ตูเกโร

nameCheck.why: ตอร์ตูเกโร is a plausible transliteration of Tortuguero, but Thai usage typically writes "ตอร์ตูเกโร" for the town, and as a region it would normally carry a kind word such as "เขต" or refer to the national park ("อุทยานแห่งชาติตอร์ตูเกโร"), so the bare name is only moderately fitting.
